subtitle: Hardware obsolescence diagnosis and migration
placeholder: Type your answer…  (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)

disclaimer: Technical assistance. It does not replace the functional safety assessment, lockout and tagout, or the authorization of competent personnel. Verify every recommendation before intervening on real equipment.
welcome:
**Welcome to MIGRA-IA.** Two ways to use it; the first one **needs no API key and costs nothing**.

• **Interactive demo** — here **you** answer. Your equipment is identified against the verified catalog of **30 manufacturers, 130 generations and 469 CPU models**; the questions and their options come from the master questionnaire; the risk engine scores **your** answers; the decision map says what is in order for **your** case and, if migrating is the way, the **50-step** procedure guides you with the target CPU you choose (same brand or another). No language model: same case, same result, every time.

• **Real case (API)** — free-form dialogue with the complete agent. It is the one thing the demo cannot do, and it needs your ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the .env file.
err_case_expired: Case not found or session expired. Open a new case.
real_needs_key:
**The «Real case (API)» mode is not enabled on this server.** That mode talks to the Anthropic model, and that needs a paid API key: this is a non-profit academic project, so the public demo runs with no key and at no cost to whoever visits it.

**The «Interactive demo» next to it is not a cut-down version.** It is the real engine ---identification against the catalog, questionnaire, risk scoring, decision map and the 50-step procedure--- working with YOUR answers. The one thing it cannot do is hold a free-form conversation.

If you want the AI mode, install it on your own machine with your own key: it is explained in `INSTALL_GUIDE.md`, inside the repository.
err_no_credential: There is no valid Anthropic credential. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the .env file (see .env.example).
